# Roman Bandurin — Projects Catalog

> Catalog of projects published on GitHub Pages by Roman Bandurin. Each project is
> published from its own repository under its own path; this root site is the directory.

## Documentation

- [Index (HTML)](https://roman-bandurin.github.io/): the catalog page
- [AGENTS.md](https://roman-bandurin.github.io/AGENTS.md): instructions for agents, storage note about shared origin
- [index.md](https://roman-bandurin.github.io/index.md): markdown mirror of the catalog page
- [glossary.md](https://roman-bandurin.github.io/glossary.md): glossary of discovery, protocol and cryptographic terms
- [openapi.json](https://roman-bandurin.github.io/openapi.json): machine-readable catalog contract
- [sitemap.md](https://roman-bandurin.github.io/sitemap.md): structured map of agent-readable surfaces
- [sitemap.xml](https://roman-bandurin.github.io/sitemap.xml): XML sitemap (root + per-project entries)
- [robots.txt](https://roman-bandurin.github.io/robots.txt): crawler policy for the whole host

## Projects

- [Crypto — Web Crypto API Playground & Agentic Tool Server](https://roman-bandurin.github.io/crypto/): browser-based
  cryptography playground (digests, encryption, signatures, key generation) with an
  AI chat and WebMCP tool server. Fully client-side, no backend.
  - [https://roman-bandurin.github.io/crypto/llms.txt](https://roman-bandurin.github.io/crypto/llms.txt): project LLM directory
  - [https://roman-bandurin.github.io/crypto/llms-full.txt](https://roman-bandurin.github.io/crypto/llms-full.txt): full project documentation
  - [https://roman-bandurin.github.io/crypto/AGENTS.md](https://roman-bandurin.github.io/crypto/AGENTS.md): project agent instructions
  - [https://roman-bandurin.github.io/crypto/index.md](https://roman-bandurin.github.io/crypto/index.md): markdown mirror of the app page
  - [https://roman-bandurin.github.io/crypto/openapi.json](https://roman-bandurin.github.io/crypto/openapi.json): project API contract
